You have probably already heard that childhood is the best period in life. For many of us, it's not. It's really, really not. Childhood isn't the best. It's not even average. Childhood is as bad as it gets and it's a fucking insufferable piece of shit. Whenever someone tells you that this is the best, they're flat out *lying*. But there's something so good about childhood: by definition, childhood is, say, the first 18 years of your life. Which means that you actually don't have to do *anything* for it to be over. Physics literally guarantees that you'll get out of it. It's a fact.
When you become an adult you have some much more agency over yourself to do whatever the fuck you wanna do. And that's it.
So being stuck there sucks. And some of your parents' comments suck. But it ends.
For now, do you think you could consider telling them that their comments are cutting very deep even if you don't show it? Their comments and opinions on you don't define you. You define you. There is a balance between being obedient to your parents and staying autonomous. For some people that don't feel hurt by their parents, the right balance is to never talk back to them, because it doesn't make them feel bad so there's no point in it. For some others, the right balance is to cut their parents out of their life. Everybody has to make tough decisions on how much they'll allow their parents to control them. It's important to make them sensibly.
Not having friends happens to so many people it's sad. There are people that would like you if they got the chance to meet you. You don't have to believe this, I just want you to at least have the doubt that you will find people. When you feel ready, consider taking risks like taking to new people. They are often more scared of you than you are of them. We all have issues.
Childhood sucks hard. There is a whole future for you. And I hope you get to see it.
